vision_description: The page titled 'Bổ sung tín hiệu' features diagrams and an image related to signal addition. It includes graphs labeled (A), (B), and (C) showing signal functions X1(t), X2(t), and their sum Y(t) = X1(t) + X2(t). An image of audio equipment is also present.
main_message: The lecture page explains the concept of signal addition, with a practical application in audio mixing.
